//: Environment variables for the PD Conversion Harness.
Every value here is something the reference flow hard-coded into its action
inputs (see docs/Reference-Solution-Analysis.md, problem P8). The reference
flow points at the demo tenant; production is a different tenant, site,
library and folder, so there was no way to deploy it without editing the
flow. Parameterising these is what makes the harness deployable.
Defaults are deliberately EMPTY for anything environment-specific. A blank
default fails visibly at import or at the input gate; a demo-tenant default
would silently run against the wrong site.
Values marked CONTRACT must agree with the pd-ad-conversion skill's own
constants in pd_tools.py. scripts/validate_harness.py asserts this. If they
drift, the flow enqueues work the skill silently skips - which costs a
metered agent call per skipped document and reports nothing.

publisher.//: Deliberate publisher. The reference solution used 'CDS Default Publisher' (prefix cr50b), which is the maker-portal default rather than a choice.

environmentVariables.description: Absolute site URL. Passed to the agent as siteUrl and used as the 'dataset' parameter on every SharePoint action. Reference flow hard-coded the demo tenant here.

The library's URL name, not its display name. The investigation report records this as a recurring trap: 'Documents' vs 'Shared Documents', and on the customer site the library is 'wfpp' while the folder inside it is confusingly named 'PD-AD Library'.

Server-relative path of the folder holding position folders. The walk starts here. Type plain spaces, never %20: Power Automate encodes the Uri field, so a pre-entered %20 becomes %2520 and the request silently loses its query string.

Server-relative path of the FOLDER of templates, passed to the agent as templatePath. SKILL.md section 'Inputs': 'a path to a folder means every .docx in it, each producing its own output. A template folder is the normal case.' Passing a folder is correct, not a defect. MUST NOT overlap SourceRootPath.

CONTRACT. Comma-separated folder names never descended into. Must equal pd_tools.py OUTPUT_FOLDERS = (ARCHIVE_FOLDER_NAME, AD_FOLDER_NAME) = ('Archive', 'AD Documents'). These hold the skill's own output; descending into them would feed the agent its own previous results. Investigation report R4 requires the same exclusions.

CONTRACT. Must equal pd_tools.py CONVERTIBLE_EXT = ('.pdf', '.docx'). NOTE: the investigation report's R3 also lists .doc, but the skill does not accept it - a .doc source is reported as not convertible. Adding .doc here would spend an agent call to be told that. Raised as an open question rather than silently reconciled.

Hard cap on agent invocations in a single run. THE PRIMARY COST CONTROL. Defaults to 1 so the first run after any deployment converts exactly one document and can be inspected. Raise only after measuring what one conversion costs and how long it takes.

When true the harness enumerates, filters and emits the full plan, then stops WITHOUT invoking the agent. Zero metered cost. Defaults to true so a fresh deployment cannot convert documents before someone has read a plan.

Depth limit for the breadth-first walk. A guard against an unexpectedly deep or cyclic tree turning one run into an unbounded one. Investigation report R2 requires no assumption about depth, so this is a safety ceiling rather than an expected limit; the plan reports whether it was hit.

Ceiling on folders enumerated per run. Bounds both run duration and SharePoint call count against the connector's 600-calls-per-minute limit. The walk reports truncation explicitly rather than silently returning a short list.

REUSED EXISTING AGENT - 'PD Conversion Assistant'. Schema name, not a record GUID, which is why it is portable across environments. Evidence it is an environment resource rather than ours: it is not a RootComponent of the reference solution, customizations.xml has no <bots> element, and its prefix (cree1_) differs from that solution's publisher prefix (cr50b). Defaulted rather than blank because it is the one value that is NOT environment-specific.
Free-text label stamped on the run output, for correlating a run with whatever prompted it. Purely observational; nothing branches on it.

connectionReferences.description: Standard SharePoint connector. Used for the folder walk and for reading file properties. Standard licensing only - no premium connector anywhere in the harness (investigation report R6).
Invokes the Copilot Studio agent via the InvokeAgent operation. This is the mechanism the reference flow uses, confirmed from its exported definition rather than guessed.
